selector.why: The histopathologic findings of a plate-like subepidermal tumor with multiple cord-like connections to the overlying epidermis and neoplastic cords consisting of clear/pale epithelial cells with strong periodic acid-Schiff staining due to glycogen accumulation specifically support Tumors of the follicular infundibulum (TFI).
